title: Vodka hub universal
script:
-- [[ VODKA HUB UNIVERSAL V4.4 - Fixed Aimbot & Fly ]]
print("Vodka Hub: Script Started")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("VodkaHubV4") then PlayerGui.VodkaHubV4:Destroy() end

-- ===== VARIABLES =====
local UI_RainbowEnabled = false
local AimbotEnabled = false
local TeamCheckEnabled = true
local WallCheckEnabled = false
local FOVCircleEnabled = true
local ESP_RainbowEnabled = false
local ESP_SkeletonEnabled = false
local ESP_ShowTrackers = false
local ESP_ShowDot = false
local NoClipEnabled = false
local InfJumpEnabled = false
local KeybindEnabled = true
local FlyEnabled = false

local FOVRadius = 150
local Smoothness = 20
local RainbowSpeed = 5
local MaxESPDistance = 500
local WalkSpeed = 16
local DotSize = 6
local FlyHeight = 20

-- Target Variables
local TargetList = {}
local CurrentTargetIndex = 1
local isSpectating = false
local isOrbiting = false
local OrbitSpeed = 2
local OrbitDistance = 5

local TitleLabel = nil

-- ===== UI BUILD =====
local uiSuccess, uiErr = pcall(function()
    local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    ScreenGui.Name = "VodkaHubV4"
    ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui
    ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 999

    -- Toggle Button
    local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    ToggleBtn.Parent = ScreenGui
    ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 45)
    ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 150)
    ToggleBtn.Text = "VH"
    ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
    ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
    ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    ToggleBtn.TextSize = 18
    ToggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 2
    ToggleBtn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
    local TCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); TCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn; TCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local draggingBtn, dragStartBtn, startPosBtn
    ToggleBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingBtn = true; dragStartBtn = input.Position; startPosBtn = ToggleBtn.Position
        end
    end)
    ToggleBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingBtn = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingBtn and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStartBtn
            ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(startPosBtn.X.Scale, startPosBtn.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosBtn.Y.Scale, startPosBtn.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)

    -- Main Frame
    local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
    MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 320)
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.5, -160)
    MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
    MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    MainFrame.Visible = false
    MainFrame.Active = true
    local MCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); MCorner.Parent = MainFrame; MCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    -- Top Bar
    local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    TopBar.Parent = MainFrame; TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35); TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25); TopBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    local TopCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); TopCorner.Parent = TopBar; TopCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    TitleLabel.Parent = TopBar; TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0); TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    TitleLabel.Text = "VODKA HUB V4.4"; TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0); TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1; TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; TitleLabel.TextSize = 16; TitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    CloseBtn.Parent = TopBar; CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 35); CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 0); CloseBtn.Text = "X"; CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100); CloseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; CloseBtn.TextSize = 16

    local draggingMain, dragStartMain, startPosMain
    TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingMain = true; dragStartMain = input.Position; startPosMain = MainFrame.Position
        end
    end)
    TopBar.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingMain = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingMain and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStartMain
            MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPosMain.X.Scale, startPosMain.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosMain.Y.Scale, startPosMain.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)

    -- Sidebar
    local Sidebar = Instance.new("Frame")
    Sidebar.Parent = MainFrame; Sidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 1, -35); Sidebar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35); Sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20); Sidebar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    local SLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); SLayout.Parent = Sidebar; SLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; SLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    local SPad = Instance.new("UIPadding"); SPad.Parent = Sidebar; SPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local function CreateTabBtn(name, order)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Parent = Sidebar; btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35); btn.Text = name; btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200); btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30); btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; btn.TextSize = 12; btn.BorderSizePixel = 0; btn.LayoutOrder = order
        return btn
    end

    local TabCombat = CreateTabBtn("Combat", 1)
    local TabPlayer = CreateTabBtn("Player", 2)
    local TabVisuals = CreateTabBtn("Visuals", 3)
    local TabTarget = CreateTabBtn("Target", 4)
    local TabSettings = CreateTabBtn("Settings", 5)

    local function CreateScrollFrame(parent)
        local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        scroll.Parent = parent; scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10); scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5); scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1; scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0; scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4; scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0); scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); layout.Parent = scroll; layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
        layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function() scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10) end)
        return scroll
    end

    local function CreateToggle(parent, text, default, callback)
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame"); frame.Parent = parent; frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30); frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel"); label.Parent = frame; label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0); label.Text = text; label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220); label.BackgroundTransparency = 1; label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; label.TextSize = 13; label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.Parent = frame; btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 24); btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 3); btn.Text = default and "ON" or "OFF"; btn.BackgroundColor3 = default and Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40); btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; btn.TextSize = 12; btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4); corner.Parent = btn
        local state = default
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            state = not state; btn.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"; btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
            if callback then callback(state) end
        end)
        return frame
    end

    local function CreateSlider(parent, text, min, max, default, callback)
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame"); frame.Parent = parent; frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40); frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel"); label.Parent = frame; label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15); label.Text = text .. ": " .. tostring(default); label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220); label.BackgroundTransparency = 1; label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; label.TextSize = 12; label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        local bar = Instance.new("Frame"); bar.Parent = frame; bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 6); bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 25); bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
        local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); barCorner.Parent = bar
        local fill = Instance.new("Frame"); fill.Parent = bar; fill.Size = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min), 0, 1, 0); fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
        local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); fillCorner.Parent = fill
        local draggingSlider = false
        local function update(input)
            local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local val = math.floor(min + ((max - min) * pos))
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0); label.Text = text .. ": " .. tostring(val)
            if callback then callback(val) end
        end
        bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingSlider = true end end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input) if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingSlider = false end end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input) if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then update(input) end end)
        return frame
    end

    local PageCombat = CreateScrollFrame(MainFrame)
    local PagePlayer = CreateScrollFrame(MainFrame)
    local PageVisuals = CreateScrollFrame(MainFrame)
    local PageTarget = CreateScrollFrame(MainFrame)
    local PageSettings = CreateScrollFrame(MainFrame)

    for _, page in pairs({PageCombat, PagePlayer, PageVisuals, PageTarget, PageSettings}) do
        page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 40); page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -85, 1, -45)
    end

    -- COMBAT
    CreateToggle(PageCombat, "Aimbot", false, function(s) AimbotEnabled = s end)
    CreateToggle(PageCombat, "Team Check", true, function(s) TeamCheckEnabled = s end)
    CreateToggle(PageCombat, "Wall Check", false, function(s) WallCheckEnabled = s end)
    CreateToggle(PageCombat, "FOV Circle", true, function(s) FOVCircleEnabled = s end)
    CreateSlider(PageCombat, "FOV Radius", 50, 500, 150, function(v) FOVRadius = v end)
    CreateSlider(PageCombat, "Smoothness (100=Hard)", 0, 100, 20, function(v) Smoothness = v end)

    -- PLAYER
    CreateToggle(PagePlayer, "NoClip", false, function(s) NoClipEnabled = s end)
    CreateToggle(PagePlayer, "Infinite Jump", false, function(s) InfJumpEnabled = s end)
    CreateToggle(PagePlayer, "Fly / Hover", false, function(s) FlyEnabled = s end)
    CreateSlider(PagePlayer, "Fly Height", 5, 100, 20, function(v) FlyHeight = v end)
    CreateSlider(PagePlayer, "Walk Speed", 16, 200, 16, function(v)
        WalkSpeed = v
        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = v end
    end)

    -- VISUALS
    CreateToggle(PageVisuals, "Rainbow ESP", false, function(s) ESP_RainbowEnabled = s end)
    CreateToggle(PageVisuals, "Skeleton ESP", false, function(s) ESP_SkeletonEnabled = s end)
    CreateToggle(PageVisuals, "Tracker Lines", false, function(s) ESP_ShowTrackers = s end)
    CreateToggle(PageVisuals, "Red Dot ESP", false, function(s) ESP_ShowDot = s end)
    CreateSlider(PageVisuals, "Red Dot Size", 2, 15, 6, function(v) DotSize = v end)
    CreateSlider(PageVisuals, "Max ESP Distance", 50, 2000, 500, function(v) MaxESPDistance = v end)
    CreateSlider(PageVisuals, "Rainbow Speed", 1, 10, 5, function(v) RainbowSpeed = v end)

    -- TARGET TAB 
    local targetMenu = Instance.new("Frame")
    targetMenu.Parent = PageTarget; targetMenu.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 180); targetMenu.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25); targetMenu.BorderSizePixel = 0
    local tmCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); tmCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4); tmCorner.Parent = targetMenu

    TargetNameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    TargetNameLabel.Parent = targetMenu; TargetNameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 30); TargetNameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 5)
    TargetNameLabel.Text = "None"; TargetNameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0); TargetNameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1; TargetNameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; TargetNameLabel.TextSize = 14

    local prevBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    prevBtn.Parent = targetMenu; prevBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25); prevBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 8); prevBtn.Text = "<"; prevBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40); prevBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); prevBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    local nextBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    nextBtn.Parent = targetMenu; nextBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25); nextBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 8); nextBtn.Text = ">"; nextBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40); nextBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); nextBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    local function UpdateTargetDisplay()
        if #TargetList > 0 then
            if CurrentTargetIndex > #TargetList then CurrentTargetIndex = 1 end
            if CurrentTargetIndex < 1 then CurrentTargetIndex = #TargetList end
            TargetNameLabel.Text = TargetList[CurrentTargetIndex].Name
        else
            TargetNameLabel.Text = "None"
        end
    end

    prevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() CurrentTargetIndex = CurrentTargetIndex - 1; UpdateTargetDisplay() end)
    nextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() CurrentTargetIndex = CurrentTargetIndex + 1; UpdateTargetDisplay() end)

    local specToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    specToggleBtn.Parent = targetMenu; specToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, -10, 0, 25); specToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 45); specToggleBtn.Text = "Spectate"; specToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40); specToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); specToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; specToggleBtn.TextSize = 12
    local specCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); specCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4); specCorner.Parent = specToggleBtn

    local orbitBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    orbitBtn.Parent = targetMenu; orbitBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, -10, 0, 25); orbitBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 5, 0, 45); orbitBtn.Text = "Target (Orbit)"; orbitBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40); orbitBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); orbitBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; orbitBtn.TextSize = 12
    local orbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); orbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4); orbCorner.Parent = orbitBtn

    CreateSlider(targetMenu, "Orbit Distance", 5, 50, 5, function(v) OrbitDistance = v end).Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 75)
    CreateSlider(targetMenu, "Orbit Speed", 1, 50, 2, function(v) OrbitSpeed = v end).Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 115)

    specToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        isSpectating = not isSpectating
        if isSpectating then
            specToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
            specToggleBtn.Text = "Spectating"
        else
            specToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
            specToggleBtn.Text = "Spectate"
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                Camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
            end
        end
    end)

    orbitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        isOrbiting = not isOrbiting
        if isOrbiting then
            orbitBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
        else
            orbitBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
        end
    end)

    local refreshBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); refreshBtn.Parent = PageTarget; refreshBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30); refreshBtn.Text = "Refresh List"; refreshBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40); refreshBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0); refreshBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; refreshBtn.TextSize = 13; refreshBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    local refCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); refCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4); refCorner.Parent = refreshBtn
    
    local function RefreshTargetList()
        TargetList = {}
        for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(TargetList, plr) end
        end
        CurrentTargetIndex = 1
        UpdateTargetDisplay()
    end
    refreshBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(RefreshTargetList)
    RefreshTargetList()

    -- SETTINGS
    CreateToggle(PageSettings, "UI Rainbow Mode", false, function(s) UI_RainbowEnabled = s end)
    
    local pcInfo = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    pcInfo.Parent = PageSettings; pcInfo.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); pcInfo.Text = "PC Users: Right Shift to toggle menu"; pcInfo.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150); pcInfo.BackgroundTransparency = 1; pcInfo.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; pcInfo.TextSize = 11; pcInfo.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    CreateToggle(PageSettings, "Enable RightShift Keybind", true, function(s) KeybindEnabled = s end)

    local DiscordBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); DiscordBtn.Parent = PageSettings; DiscordBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30); DiscordBtn.Text = "Copy Discord Invite"; DiscordBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242); DiscordBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); DiscordBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; DiscordBtn.TextSize = 13
    local DiscordCorner = Instance.new("UICorner"); DiscordCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4); DiscordCorner.Parent = DiscordBtn
    DiscordBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setclipboard("https://discord.gg/vodkahub") end)

    -- Tab Logic
    local function HideAll() PageCombat.Visible = false; PagePlayer.Visible = false; PageVisuals.Visible = false; PageTarget.Visible = false; PageSettings.Visible = false end
    local function SwitchTab(page, btn)
        HideAll(); page.Visible = true
        for _, b in pairs(Sidebar:GetChildren()) do if b:IsA("TextButton") then b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200); b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30) end end
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0); btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    end
    TabCombat.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(PageCombat, TabCombat) end)
    TabPlayer.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(PagePlayer, TabPlayer) end)
    TabVisuals.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(PageVisuals, TabVisuals) end)
    TabTarget.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(PageTarget, TabTarget) end)
    TabSettings.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(PageSettings, TabSettings) end)
    SwitchTab(PageCombat, TabCombat)

    ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible end)
    CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() MainFrame.Visible = false end)
    
    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if gameProcessed then return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift and KeybindEnabled then 
            MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible 
        end
    end)
end)

if not uiSuccess then warn("UI Error: " .. tostring(uiErr)) end

-- ===== GAME LOGIC =====
task.spawn(function()
    local DrawingLib = Drawing
    local FOVCircle = DrawingLib.new("Circle")
    FOVCircle.Thickness = 1; FOVCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0); FOVCircle.Filled = false

    local r15Bones = {{"Head", "UpperTorso"}, {"UpperTorso", "LowerTorso"}, {"UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm"}, {"LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm"}, {"UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm"}, {"RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm"}, {"LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg"}, {"LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg"}, {"LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg"}, {"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg"}}
    local r6Bones = {{"Head", "Torso"}, {"Torso", "Left Arm"}, {"Torso", "Right Arm"}, {"Torso", "Left Leg"}, {"Torso", "Right Leg"}}
    local espCache = {}

    local function createESP(plr)
        if plr == LocalPlayer then return end
        local lines = {}
        for i = 1, 15 do
            local line = DrawingLib.new("Line"); line.Thickness = 1.5; line.Transparency = 1; line.Visible = false
            table.insert(lines, line)
        end
        local trackerLine = DrawingLib.new("Line"); trackerLine.Thickness = 1.5; trackerLine.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0); trackerLine.Visible = false
        local dot = DrawingLib.new("Circle"); dot.Thickness = 1; dot.Filled = true; dot.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0); dot.Visible = false
        espCache[plr] = {Lines = lines, Tracker = trackerLine, Dot = dot}
    end

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do createESP(p) end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(createESP)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) if espCache[p] then for _, l in pairs(espCache[p].Lines) do l:Remove() end espCache[p].Tracker:Remove(); espCache[p].Dot:Remove(); espCache[p] = nil end end)

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(1)
        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = WalkSpeed end
    end)

    -- Aimbot Target Function
    local function GetClosestTarget()
        local closest, minDist = nil, FOVRadius
        local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
        
        for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                if TeamCheckEnabled and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then continue end
                
                local head = plr.Character.Head
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                
                if onScreen then
                    if WallCheckEnabled then
                        local obscuring = Camera:GetPartsObscuringTarget({Camera.CFrame.Position, head.Position}, {LocalPlayer.Character, plr.Character})
                        if #obscuring > 0 then continue end
                    end
                    
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if dist < minDist then
                        minDist = dist
                        closest = head
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return closest
    end

    RunService:BindToRenderStep("VHLogic", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
        if UI_RainbowEnabled and TitleLabel then TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV((tick() * 0.5) % 1, 1, 1) end
        
        if FOVCircleEnabled then
            FOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2); FOVCircle.Radius = FOVRadius; FOVCircle.Visible = true
        else FOVCircle.Visible = false end

        -- Aimbot Execution
        if AimbotEnabled then
            local target = GetClosestTarget()
            if target then
                local alpha = math.clamp(Smoothness / 100, 0.01, 1)
                Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, target.Position), alpha)
            end
        end

        local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV((tick() * (RainbowSpeed / 10)) % 1, 1, 1)
        
        if isSpectating and TargetList[CurrentTargetIndex] and TargetList[CurrentTargetIndex].Character and TargetList[CurrentTargetIndex].Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            Camera.CameraSubject = TargetList[CurrentTargetIndex].Character.Humanoid
        end

        if isOrbiting and TargetList[CurrentTargetIndex] and TargetList[CurrentTargetIndex].Character and TargetList[CurrentTargetIndex].Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local targetPos = TargetList[CurrentTargetIndex].Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            local angle = tick() * OrbitSpeed
            local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * OrbitDistance, 2, math.sin(angle) * OrbitDistance)
            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos + offset, targetPos)
        end

        for plr, data in pairs(espCache) do
            local isWithinDistance = false
            local head = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            
            if head then
                local dist = (Camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
                if dist <= MaxESPDistance then isWithinDistance = true end
            end

            if plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and plr.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 and isWithinDistance then
                local isR15 = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
                local bones = isR15 and r15Bones or r6Bones
                
                for i, bone in ipairs(bones) do
                    local p1 = plr.Character:FindFirstChild(bone[1]); local p2 = plr.Character:FindFirstChild(bone[2]); local line = data.Lines[i]
                    if p1 and p2 and line then
                        local v1, on1 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p1.Position); local v2, on2 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p2.Position)
                        if on1 and on2 and (ESP_RainbowEnabled or ESP_SkeletonEnabled) then
                            line.From = Vector2.new(v1.X, v1.Y); line.To = Vector2.new(v2.X, v2.Y)
                            line.Color = ESP_RainbowEnabled and rainbowColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); line.Visible = true
                        else line.Visible = false end
                    end
                end
                
                if ESP_ShowTrackers and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local bodyPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        data.Tracker.From = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                        data.Tracker.To = Vector2.new(bodyPos.X, bodyPos.Y)
                        data.Tracker.Visible = true
                    else data.Tracker.Visible = false end
                else data.Tracker.Visible = false end

                if head and ESP_ShowDot then
                    local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        data.Dot.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) 
                        data.Dot.Radius = DotSize
                        data.Dot.Visible = true
                    else data.Dot.Visible = false end
                else data.Dot.Visible = false end
            else
                for _, line in pairs(data.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
                data.Tracker.Visible = false
                data.Dot.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end)

    RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        -- NoClip
        if NoClipEnabled and LocalPlayer.Character then
            for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
        
        -- Fly/Hover (Uses HipHeight for smooth float)
        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if FlyEnabled then
                LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.HipHeight = FlyHeight
            else
                -- Reset to default based on Rig Type
                if LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    if LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") then -- R15
                        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.HipHeight = 2.0
                    else -- R6
                        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.HipHeight = 0.0
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
        if InfJumpEnabled and LocalPlayer.Character then
            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
        end
    end)
end)
